key.name: panel-position
key.description: Place the indicator on the left, in the center or on the right of the top bar.

key.name: show-flatpak
key.description: Include Flatpak applications, runtimes and extensions in update checks when Flatpak is installed.

key.name: show-aur
key.description: Check published AUR versions of installed foreign packages on Arch-based systems. Sends package names to aur.archlinux.org. Does not track new VCS commits. Ignored on other distributions.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to query package updates and enabled optional sources.
